title: GraphQL: Filter, Sort and Page Content Items | Orchard Core
description:
A GraphQL query for a content type returns up to 100 published items, newest first, and a client rarely wants exactly that.

The arguments of a content type query filter the items, sort them, take a page of them and choose which version of each item to return, and three settings limit the number of results.

In this video:
• The five arguments of a content type query and their defaults
• Filter with where: fields, parts and the OR, AND and NOT conditions
• The filter operators for strings, identifiers, dates and content fields
• Sort with orderBy
• Page with first and skip
• Choose versions with status: PUBLISHED, DRAFT, LATEST and ALL
• Combine the arguments in one query
• The default and maximum number of results, and the validation mode
